# Game controllers script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run Python code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-python-step.png)

## controllers.get

Finds one game controller and tells you about it. Starts watching controllers if needed.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `controller` | `controller` | Optional. Which controller: a slot like "#1", part of its name, its type (like "PS5") or its GUID. Default "#1". |

**Gives back:** The controller's details (name, slot, type, battery, held buttons, axes, hats), or null when none matches.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("controllers.get", new { controller = "#1" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.controllers_get(controller="#1")
    ```

## controllers.learn

Waits for you to press a button, move a stick or push the d-pad, then tells you what it was. Handy for finding a button's name.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `timeoutMs` | `timeout_ms` | Optional. How long to wait, in milliseconds (100 to 300000). Default 10000 (10 seconds). |
| `controller` | `controller` | Optional. Only listen to this controller (slot like "#1", name, type or GUID). Leave it out to listen to all. |

**Gives back:** What was pressed: kind, name, label, controller (its details), triggerType, settings and description. null when nothing was pressed in time.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("controllers.learn", new { timeoutMs = 15000 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.controllers_learn(timeout_ms=15000)
    ```

## controllers.list

Lists the game controllers that are plugged in right now. Starts watching controllers if it was not already. Fails with an error when controller input is turned off.

**Gives back:** A list of controllers. Each has its name, slot number, type, battery, held buttons, axes (stick and trigger values) and hats (d-pad directions).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("controllers.list");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.controllers_list()
    ```

## controllers.reloadMappings

Reads the controller mappings file (gamecontrollerdb.txt) again, so new controller types are known. Fails with an error when there is no such file.

**Gives back:** How many mappings were added. 0 when controller input is not running yet (the file is read when it starts).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("controllers.reloadMappings");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.controllers_reload_mappings()
    ```

## controllers.rumble

Makes a game controller shake (rumble). Fails with an error when controller input is turned off.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `controller` | `controller` | Optional. Which controller: a slot like "#1", part of its name, its type or GUID. Several can be split with commas. Default "Any" (all of them). |
| `low` | `low` | Optional. Strength of the big, slow motor, 0-100 percent. Default 50. |
| `high` | `high` | Optional. Strength of the small, fast motor, 0-100 percent. Default 50. |
| `durationMs` | `duration_ms` | Optional. How long to shake, in milliseconds (1000 = 1 second, at most 60000). Default 500. |

**Gives back:** How many controllers shook.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("controllers.rumble", new { controller = "#1", low = 80, high = 80, durationMs = 1000 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.controllers_rumble(controller="#1", low=80, high=80, duration_ms=1000)
    ```

## controllers.setLed

Changes the light colour on game controllers that have one, like a PlayStation controller. Fails with an error when the colour cannot be read.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `controller` | `controller` | Optional. Which controller: a slot like "#1", part of its name, its type or GUID. Default "Any" (all of them). |
| `color` | `color` | The colour as "#RRGGBB" (like "#FF0000" for red) or "r,g,b" (like "255,0,0"). |

**Gives back:** How many controllers changed colour.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("controllers.setLed", new { color = "#9146FF" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.controllers_set_led(color="#9146FF")
    ```

## controllers.status

Tells you whether game controller input is running and how.

**Gives back:** running (true/false), backend (the controller library in use), version, state, message (a status line) and mode (the watch setting from the Controllers page).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("controllers.status");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.controllers_status()
    ```
